## STRATEGIES AND HARD RULES
[shr-00001] When the task is to 'look at' an object and the object is visible or accessible in its current location, then examine the object in place (e.g., 'examine <object>') instead of taking it unless the object is hidden or requires being picked up to be viewed.
[shr-00002] When an object is already visible and accessible, and repeated examination of its location yields no new information or environmental change, then stop examining the location and proceed to examine or interact with the object directly.
[shr-00008] When the task is to 'examine <object> with <tool>' and both the object and the tool are visible and accessible, then directly perform the action 'use <tool> on <object>' to fulfill the task requirement, without first using the tool alone or interacting with unrelated objects.
[shr-00021] When the task is to 'look at <object> with <tool>' and the object is not in the correct relative position (e.g., not under the desklamp), then first adjust the object's position to satisfy the spatial condition before applying the tool directly to the object.

[vc-00003] Before taking an object for the purpose of 'looking at' it, verify that the object is already visible and accessible in its current location. If so, examine it in place instead.
[vc-00004] Before performing any action to interact with an object for the purpose of 'looking at' it, verify that the object is both visible and accessible in its current location. If so, proceed to examine it in place instead of taking or moving it.

If the position is not correct, adjust the object's position or confirm that the task's spatial condition is satisfied.
[vc-00006] Before examining an object with a specified tool (e.g., 'with the desklamp'), verify that the tool is accessible and that using it on the object will yield the intended examination. If so, use the tool directly on the object instead of performing redundant or irrelevant actions.
[vc-00007] Before completing the task of 'examining an object with a tool', verify that the tool has been directly applied to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>'). If not, perform this action to fulfill the task's requirement.
[vc-00009] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the tool is being applied directly to the correct object as specified in the task (e.g., 'use desklamp on bowl'). If not, adjust the action to ensure the tool is used on the correct object.
